name: Forum of Azor
description: A huge flat public forum where any Ravnican can be heard; its magic was lifted by Isperia's decree.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace's memory of becoming the Living Guildpact at the Forum of Azor.
timeline.quote: It was the day Jace became the Living Guildpact.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Isperia lifts the Forum's rigid magical controls, reviving it as an open civic space.
timeline.quote: Isperia — then the Azorius guildmaster — lifted the rigid magical controls over the Forum.

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana delivers the Fathom Edict announcing the rebirth of the Simic.
timeline.quote: Zegana announced the rebirth of the Simic under new philosophical principles

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace discovers the Bailiff and learns of the Supreme Verdict; Lazav also speaks to the Bailiff.
timeline.quote: As Jace left, Lazav also spoke to the bailiff to learn its secrets.

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Bailiff pronounces the Supreme Verdict; Jace links the runners' minds to prevent catastrophe and is named the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: the bailiff named Jace the new Living Guildpact

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace links the maze-runners' minds and is declared the new Guildpact by the Bailiff.
timeline.quote: Jace connected their ten minds to prevent any from casting the verdict.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Bailiff declares Jace the new Guildpact.
timeline.quote: the Bailiff had declared Jace the new Guildpact

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isperia decrees the magic lifted from the Forum of Azor, reviving it as a chaotic public space.
timeline.quote: Isperia decreed that the magic be lifted from the Forum
